Why a forest?

Each tree sees a different slice of the data, so their votes cancel out individual mistakes. It handles the PCA components without extra scaling and gives a strong middle ground between the linear baseline and the slower neighbour search.

Read the results

Compare accuracy with macro-F1 to spot weak classes, then check train and predict time for the cost of each win. Shirt and T-shirt are the usual troublemakers, while Trouser and Bag achieve over 95% precision.
